_comment: Witnesses for tests/unit/costs/test_ability_cost_floor.py. `t_acf_node` carries Convergence of Dominion's Dynastic Command Node on a bare enchantment. `t_acf_two` and `t_acf_pip` are graveyard-active abilities costing {2} and {B}, the floor's two boundaries; Reassembling Skeleton ({1}{B}) is the shipped coloured case. `t_acf_engine` is the same {2} ability active on the battlefield, the near miss the discount must not reach. `t_acf_plain` is the node without its floor, the unfloored contrast.
